question: Should OpenClaw ship the full opt-in bundled Workspaces feature, including agent-authored sandboxed custom widgets, after the concrete correctness, proof, and conflict blockers are resolved?
rationale: The PR establishes a major permanent bundled product surface and a novel custom-code trust boundary; technical review cannot decide whether maintainers want to own that long-term scope.

options.title: Sponsor the full feature
options.body: Accept bundled Workspaces and custom widgets after the lifecycle, bridge, proof, and conflict blockers are resolved.

options.title: Defer custom widgets
options.body: Land the workspace document and trusted built-in widgets while postponing agent-authored widget execution to a separately approved change.

options.title: Keep the feature external
options.body: Do not bundle this surface if maintainers prefer the product and custom-code boundary to remain in an external plugin.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the full feature
recommendation.body: Accept bundled Workspaces and custom widgets after the lifecycle, bridge, proof, and conflict blockers are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The current assignee and consolidation author is the best available owner for the bundled product and security-scope decision.
